output.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(net_revenue), 2) AS revenue_2025 FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE is_revenue AND order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
output.explanation: Revenue is the net revenue of completed orders (is_revenue = true) placed in fiscal year 2025, which is the same as calendar 2025. Shipping fees are left out.
